name: What should I look for when choosing a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a general contractor, look for experience with projects similar to yours, a strong portfolio, and positive references from past clients. Verify their licensing and insurance to ensure they are properly credentialed and protected. Good communication skills, transparency in pricing, and a clear contract are also important indicators of a reliable contractor. Get multiple bids to compare services and costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for experience, a strong portfolio, references, proper licensing and insurance, and good communication skills.
